info.name: WarpTalk Backend API
info.description:
Full API surface of the WarpTalk backend microservices, organized to mirror the backend's own module layout (auth, workspace, billing, meeting, translation-room, transcript, notification, assistant, gateway).

All requests go through the API Gateway (YARP) at `{{baseUrl}}` (default `http://localhost:5200` for local dev) — do not call the downstream services' own ports directly unless you're debugging routing.

**Auth setup:** run `Auth > Account > Login`, then copy `accessToken` / `refreshToken` from the response into this environment's variables. The collection's Bearer auth uses `{{accessToken}}` and is inherited by every request except the ones explicitly marked 'Auth: none' (registration, login, public plans, webhooks, etc.).

**Request bodies are best-effort scaffolding**, inferred from the backend's DTO type names (noted in each request's description) rather than read field-by-field from the DTO source — check the actual request DTO in the corresponding service before relying on exact field names.

**Known gaps / notes:**
- `billing-policy` endpoints may not be reachable through the gateway (its YARP route only catches `/api/v1/billing/**`, not the hyphenated `/api/v1/billing-policy` segment) — verify before use.
- `/api/v1/refunds/**` has a gateway route but no controller currently implements it — not included here as a real request.
- The `payment/` module folder in the backend repo is an unimplemented stub; all payment/checkout logic currently lives in `billing`.
- SignalR hubs are documented as plain GET placeholders for reference only — test them with a WebSocket/SignalR client, not Postman's HTTP request runner.
